title: Per-device KV footprint calibration and hot-start hysteresis for new GPU families
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Background: As we onboard newer GPU families (A100/H100/L40S/MI300 variants) we've observed non-linear growth in KV cache memory usage and much faster warm-up paths for certain model shapes. Problem: Our current per-variant published profile uses a single 'cold' and 'warm' bucket and a fixed hysteresis window for hot-start behavior; this leads to either unnecessary memory overcommit or poor latency for bursty request patterns on some devices. Objective: Create a per-device footprint calibration that measures percentiles of KV and working-set usage, derive a compact footprint signature, and introduce a configurable hot-start hysteresis policy that can be published with profile metadata. This ticket drives experiments, a calibration harness, and the publication pipeline changes to include the new metadata fields.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration harness runs on A100/H100/L40S/MI300 variants and produces per-device 50/90/99 percentile KV footprint reports
New footprint signature (small JSON string) attached to variant profiles and stored in the profile registry
Runtime can consume hysteresis_min_secs and hysteresis_multiplier fields per-variant and demonstrate reduced tail latency in synthetic burst tests
Documentation and console UI updated to show footprint percentiles and hysteresis settings for each published variant
Automated regression test covers memory overcommit scenario and ensures fallback to conservative defaults
steps: Design calibration harness: sample KV and working-set memory during synthetic and production-like traces (tooling: perf counters + agent snapshot)
Implement offline analyzer to compute percentile curves and compress into footprint signature (target < 1KB per variant)
Extend profile schema to include footprint_percentiles and hysteresis_{min_secs,multiplier}
Run calibration jobs across fleet of devices; collect and consolidate signatures into staging registry
Ship runtime change that honors hysteresis fields and can be toggled via rollout flag
Add publication playbook step and automated validation before promoting a profile to stable
